a.prompt:
STYLE: 1930s rubber hose cartoon, hand-inked cel animation look, original characters.
Thick uniform outline in dark plum #3D3346 on every shape, clean confident lines, no sketchy strokes.
Flat cel colors with at most one soft shade tone per color, no gradients on characters, no 3D rendering, no glossy plastic look; one small white highlight dot is allowed.
Characters: bendy rubber hose arms and legs with no elbows or knees, white four-finger cartoon gloves, big round shoes, pie-cut eyes (black ovals with a small wedge cut out), simple wide mouth, big head-to-body ratio.
Character colors are saturated: red #D2463C, blue #3E6DB5, yellow #F2C14E, cream #F4E6C8, glove white #FBF6EA.
Backgrounds and large props look like faded watercolor on paper in beige #CFAC8D, sand #D7BE97, dusty navy #4E546E, muted olive #8A9A6B, warm grey #907F77, and are LESS saturated than the characters.
Soft light from the top-left. No cast shadow on the ground. No text, letters or numbers anywhere.
Do not copy any existing cartoon or game character, logo, or scene.

Each item isolated on a flat solid #FF00FF magenta background (or transparent), full figure visible, nothing cropped, wide empty margin around every item, no ground line, no floor, no frame, no border, no shadow under the item.
Characters face the viewer at a slight high 3/4 angle unless a direction is given. "Side" always means facing RIGHT.

Strict side view for a 2D side-scrolling game, the camera is level with the ground (not from above). Characters face RIGHT.
Tiles and background layers marked "connect seamlessly" must match exactly at the LEFT and RIGHT edges so they can repeat.
Mid layers: draw only the lower part, leave the upper part empty flat #FF00FF magenta.

ORGEL DANCERS: small wind-up toys of the music box town, each with a wind-up key on its back, rubber hose limbs, white gloves:
TIN SOLDIER: a red #D2463C and blue #3E6DB5 tin soldier with a tall hat and a drum belt.
WIND-UP BIRD: a round yellow #F2C14E tin bird with a key on its back and tiny legs.
TOP LADY: a spinning-top shaped lady with a pink-and-cream striped skirt that is the top, a little handle hat.
About the same height as PIP.

Use case: stylized-concept. Game sprite sheet, wide landscape canvas, exactly THREE separate full figures in ONE horizontal row, left to right in the order below. Each figure fully inside its own equal-width cell, at least 100 pixels of empty magenta separating figures. Solid pure #FF00FF magenta background, no ground shadows or baselines. Each figure at least 350 pixels high. Keep identical character design, clothing, colors and proportions across the three poses. The last pose is restful and low to the ground. Only draw the one specified toy species in this sheet, never the other two species from the shared character block. No labels or captions.
JOB-SPECIFIC DIRECTION OVERRIDE: ALL THREE FIGURES FACE LEFT, including the resting pose. This overrides the generic RIGHT-facing wording above. Strict ground-level side view. Dancing poses have readable spiral eyes instead of pie-cut eyes; rested poses recover pie-cut eyes (bird half-lidded). Show the key on the back clearly. Dance poses must show clearly different alternating limb positions.
Input reference roles: style_anchor.png is the primary style and palette authority; ref_02_character.jpg is drawing-technique reference only, do not copy its character or lettering; npc_pip_awake.png establishes line weight and resident proportions. Create original toy residents in that same art style.

TIN SOLDIER dancing wildly in side view facing LEFT, one leg kicked high, arms flailing, dizzy spiral eyes, his back key spinning
TIN SOLDIER dancing wildly in side view facing LEFT, the other leg kicked high, hat tilted, dizzy spiral eyes
TIN SOLDIER sitting down on the ground in side view facing LEFT, exhausted but relieved, normal pie-cut eyes, a little sweat drop
